description: This PHP source file defines the 'WrappedHttpHandler' class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It converts a generic HTTP handler into a command-specific handler that deals with AWS-specific response parsing, error handling, and statistics collection. The class facilitates asynchronous HTTP requests and response parsing, encapsulating AWS API call logic.

classes.name: WrappedHttpHandler
classes.description: A class that adapts a generic HTTP handler into an AWS-specific command handler, managing response parsing, error handling, and optional transfer statistics collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the provided HTTP handler, parsers, exception class, and statistics collection flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the HTTP handler with given command and request, returning a promise that resolves with an AWS result or rejects with an AWS exception.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a successful HTTP response into an AWS result object, attaching metadata such as status, URI, headers, and transfer stats.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Converts a rejected HTTP response and associated error information into a specific AWS exception, parsing error details if possible.
